The Hart nods, scheduling a delayed boon for your loyalty before the encounter converges on its departure. In the aftermath, your reputation with the Ashwinter faction surges, and the White Hart is permanently etched into your quest log as a formidable guardian.

This pivotal decision immediately shifts the political landscape; your actions have earned you the unwavering loyalty of the Ashwinter rebels and unlocked the true heir as a powerful ally in the coming war, while permanently locking out any alliance with the current usurper.

output.prose_markdown: An envoy of the Ashwinter Court suddenly arrives bearing a molten ingot, demanding you forge the Crown of Embers immediately. You must decide whether to endure the searing heat to forge the artifact or defy their cruel mandate and spark a rebellion. Choosing to forge the crown requires a grueling skill check; success means you successfully craft the item while burning your hands, locking in your loyalty to the Court and scheduling a delayed audience with the monarch. The convergence point preserves these flags for future judgment. Ultimately, your sacrifice is rewarded as you gain significant favor with the Ashwinter Court and receive an exclusive Ashwinter Medallion, fundamentally altering your standing within the realm.
